eval: (()=>{if(UI.pill){const r=document.querySelector('.mobile-nav').getBoundingClientRect();if(r.left<70&&r.top<78)throw Error('Poki corner covered');}for(const e of document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav button')){const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.width<44||r.height<44)throw Error('Small navigation touch target');}return 'navigation-touch-ok';})()

(()=>{const e=document.querySelector('.hb-goal');const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();const top=document.elementFromPoint(r.x+r.width/2,r.y+r.height/2);if(!e.contains(top))throw Error('Objective text is not tappable');return [r.x+r.width/2,r.y+r.height/2];})()

(()=>{const shelf=document.querySelector('.tv-box').getBoundingClientRect();if(shelf.top>=innerHeight-100)throw Error('Storage hidden below huge party');const cards=[...document.querySelectorAll('.tv-slot')].map(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect());if(cards.some(r=>r.left<0||r.right>innerWidth+1))throw Error('Party overflow');return {storageTop:shelf.top,viewport:innerHeight};})()

(async()=>{UI.closeAll(true);for(const lang of ['en','pl','de','es','fr','it','pt','tr','ru']){setLang(lang);UI.hudBuild();Menus.navigation();await U.sleep(30);const e=document.querySelector('.nav-menu');if(e.scrollWidth>e.clientWidth+2)throw Error('Menu overflow '+lang);UI.closeAll(true);Menus.questGuide({type:'tamers',isle:'sunny'});await U.sleep(30);const g=document.querySelector('.quest-guide');if(g.scrollWidth>g.clientWidth+2)throw Error('Guide overflow '+lang);UI.closeAll(true);}setLang('pl');return '9 languages fit';})()

(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('.rv-row button');const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.bottom>innerHeight||r.top<0)throw Error('Catch confirmation outside screen');b.click();return 'duplicate-confirmation-ok';})()
